entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed.
Support. Just get me a person.
Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, you're speaking with Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet. Order number is VF-881-29B. Just need a yes or no.

Okay, I can help with that. Let me just pull up your order. I see the Aero Road Helmet here. So I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. The color is not what I expected. The box is unopened, it's brand new. I just want to send it back.
I understand. Let me just check the delivery date here... looks like it was delivered 29 days ago. One moment while I review the policy for you.
It should be fine. Your website says 90 days.
Yes, you're absolutely correct. My system confirms that you are well within the 90-day return window for this item. I can definitely process that for you.
Good. So are you sending me a shipping label or not?

Yes, I am. Your personal safety is always our priority, but we also want to make sure you're happy with your gear. I have just initiated the return and the pre-paid shipping label is on its way to your email address on file. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Got the email. Nope, that's it.
Great. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
